v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

text.la: Ego plantávi, * Apollo rigávit, Deus autem increméntum dedit, allelúia.
text.en: I have planted, * Apollos watered, but God gave the increase, alleluia.

text.la: Libénter gloriábor * in infirmitátibus meis, ut inhábitet in me virtus Christi.
text.en: Most gladly therefore will I rather glory * in my infirmities, that the power of Christ may rest upon me.

text.la: Grátia Dei * in me vácua non fuit, sed grátia eius semper in me manet.
text.en: The grace of God which was bestowed upon me was not in vain, * but His grace abideth ever in me.

text.la: Damásci, præpósitus * gentis Arétæ regis vóluit me comprehéndere: a frátribus per murum demíssus sum in sporta, et sic evási manus eius in nómine Dómini.
text.en: In Damascus the governor * under Aretas the king was desirous to apprehend me; by the brethren in a basket was I let down by the wall, and so escaped I his hands, in the name of the Lord.

text.la: Ter virgis cæsus sum, * semel lapidátus sum, ter naufrágium pértuli pro Christi nómine.
text.en: Thrice was I beaten with rods, * once was I stoned, thrice I suffered shipwreck, for Christ's name's sake.

text.la: Bonum certámen certávi, cursum consummávi, fidem servávi. In réliquo repósita est mihi coróna iustítiæ, quam reddet mihi Dóminus in illa die iustus iudex.
text.en: I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith. Henceforth there is laid up for me a crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous Judge, shall give me at that day.

v.la: Tu es vas electiónis, sancte Paule Apóstole.
v.en: O Holy Apostle Paul, thou art a chosen vessel unto God.

r.en: To preach the Gospel throughout the whole world.

text.la: Vos qui secúti estis me, * sedébitis super sedes, iudicántes duódecim tribus Israël, dicit Dóminus.
text.en: Thus saith the Lord: * Ye, which have followed Me, shall sit upon twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

text.la: Deus, qui multitúdinem géntium beáti Pauli Apóstoli prædicatióne docuísti: da nobis, quǽsumus; ut, cuius natalícia cólimus, eius apud te patrocínia sentiámus.
text.en: O God, Who, through the preaching of the Blessed Apostle Paul, hast caused the light of the Gospel to shine gloriously among the Gentiles, we beseech thee that we who keep the Feast of his birth, may, now that he is with thee, feel to our comfort that his prayer availeth much with thee.
